Container.Name: Obelisk
Container.Overview:
One container to run and manage an ARK: Survival Ascended cluster. Pick your maps and Obelisk builds the rest - generating the compose, assigning ports, keeping one shared settings file across every map, relaying chat between them and to Discord, and giving you a status page and admin controls in the browser.
Only the fields below are needed to start: one folder, the socket and a port. Everything else - maps, mods, rates, Discord, wipe schedules, time zone - is set in the web UI once it is running. After starting, check the container log for a one-time setup code, then open the WebUI.

Config.Name: Data root
Config.Description: One folder holding everything the cluster is: Obelisk's settings, every map's saves, the shared config and the cross-map transfer data. Copy this folder and you have moved the cluster. Put it on an SSD or NVMe pool, NOT the spinning array - ASA is very I/O hungry. The ~20 GB game install is kept in a sibling folder outside this one, because it re-downloads for free and keeping it out is what makes a backup portable.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets Obelisk create and manage the map containers.

Config.Name: WebUI port
Config.Description: Status page and admin UI. Change the host side here and Obelisk follows it - there is no second port to keep in sync.
